findings.title: A relational diagnosis, not a total incapacity
findings.claim: The warning diagnoses a failure of patience within an unexplained teaching relationship, rather than a deficiency in Musa across every kind of ability.
findings.mechanism: The focus capacity form at 18:67:4:1 is negated inside the with-me and patience frame at 18:67:5:1 and 18:67:6:1. The supplied patience-under-unexplained-loss relation at 12:83 and knowledge asymmetry at 2:30 make early causal closure the contact that changes the reading.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the warning as a forecast about this encounter's demands, not as a verdict on Musa's general competence.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains that al-Khidr says Musa will not be able to be patient with him; the global relation qualifies the kind of inability and does not universalize it.

epistemic.reason: The cross-run support is citable, trusted, and anchored to both supplied focus carriers; the wider connections are used as contextual contact rather than as independent proof of a new branch.

branch_activations.carrier: The negated Form X capacity expression carries a pressure of self-directed compliance and readiness to follow the stated guide.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The with-me accompaniment frame and the patience object restrict the capacity claim to following this teacher under this demand; 12:83 and 2:30 independently supply patience before unexplained outcomes and knowledge asymmetry.
branch_activations.activation: The capacity carrier contacts the relational accompaniment and delayed-judgment context, turning an abstract inability into a situated failure to sustain the learning demand.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Musa's inability is relational: sustaining patience while following this teacher, rather than lacking ability in every setting.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a qualified contextual resonance of the supplied branch and does not replace the ordinary capacity reading or make every obedience relation part of the ayah.

findings.title: Capacity changes with the companionship
findings.claim: The denied capacity is specifically relational: Musa may travel and speak, yet sustaining patience and fitting himself to the teacher's pace exceeds the demanded configuration.
findings.mechanism: The with-me word at 18:67:5:1 binds the capacity carrier at 18:67:4:1 to the patience carrier at 18:67:6:1. Its accepted compatibility facet and the later objections at 18:71 and 18:72 independently test that relation by showing the forecasted difficulty emerge as judgment before explanation.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can distinguish a limit in this learner-teacher arrangement from a claim that Musa lacks travel, speech, courage, or competence in general, while also hearing the possibility of a mismatch in how the two parties can proceed together.
findings.containment: The focus still states that patience with al-Khidr will fail; the relational reading specifies the condition under which that failure appears and does not replace the plain prediction.

epistemic.reason: The reader-walk source is legacy_unbound, but its focus anchors, branch refs, and later pericope refs are supplied; the retained relation is therefore qualified rather than treated as a universal diagnosis.

findings.title: Patience as restraint before causal closure
findings.claim: In this learning encounter, patience becomes the restraint that keeps an unexplained event from being turned into a final causal judgment too soon.
findings.mechanism: The patience carrier at 18:67:6:1 meets the supplied sequence at 18:68-72: limited knowledge names the epistemic condition, compliance is promised, questions are delayed until a report, and the first objections test that delay.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear sabr as an active discipline of waiting for the account, not merely as toughness under pain.
findings.containment: This is a qualified contextual reading of the patience named in the focus. It deepens the ordinary sense of self-restraint without claiming that the branch is exhausted by epistemic waiting or that all patience has this form.

epistemic.reason: The reader-walk source explicitly supplies the patience-to-premature-judgment relation and later sequence, but its identity is legacy_unbound; it is retained as qualified contextual evidence.
